{"metadata":{"description":"A pure client-side DSH Web plugin that turns the raw trajectory into a Chinese-first, zero-token summary view.","id":"gh:1333880279","install_available":true,"language":"JavaScript","name":"dsh-client-ui-trajectory-categories","slug":"QWQ-nn/dsh-client-ui-trajectory-categories","topics":["dsh-plugin"]},"paragraphs":[{"id":"p1s1","text":"A pure client-side DSH Web plugin that turns the raw trajectory into a Chinese-first, zero-token sum"},{"id":"p1s2","text":"ent-side DSH Web plugin that turns the raw trajectory into a Chinese-first, zero-token summary view."},{"id":"p2s1","text":"# dsh-client-ui-trajectory-categories"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"A pure client-side DSH Web plugin that turns the raw trajectory into a **Chinese-first, zero-token**"},{"id":"p3s2","text":"side DSH Web plugin that turns the raw trajectory into a **Chinese-first, zero-token** summary view."},{"id":"p4s1","text":"Adds a **「分类」 (Categories)** tab to every conversation session:"},{"id":"p5s1","text":"- **Top-left 「合计」 (Summary) panel** — action-type statistics (写入/读取/删除/下载/命令/搜索/子代理/其他工具/消息/压缩) with"},{"id":"p5s2","text":" one-click record expansion.
- **Mind-map canvas** — one problem per canvas: 问题 (problem) → 方案 (atte"},{"id":"p5s3","text":"mpt) → 工具调用 (tool calls), rebuilt from the trajectory. Switch between problems with the **「问题画布」 tab"},{"id":"p5s4","text":"s**.
- The original **Trajectory** list stays untouched."},{"id":"p6s1","text":"## Features"},{"id":"p7s1","text":"### Chinese-first categorization
- Category labels are **always Chinese**, regardless of UI language"},{"id":"p7s2","text":".
- Classification matches **both Chinese and English** tool names/terms — 写入/写文件/编辑/修改, 删除/移除, 读取/查"},{"id":"p7s3","text":"看/查找, 下载/抓取, 命令/执行/运行, 搜索/查询, 子代理/委派 … all map to the right category.
- Arg previews prioritize the "},{"id":"p7s4","text":"meaningful field (file path / URL / command / query), so rows read naturally in Chinese."},{"id":"p8s1","text":"### 「合计」 summary panel (top-left)
- **Heatmap + category ranking** (from community PR #1): a GitHub-"},{"id":"p8s2","text":"style calendar heatmap of how many actions ran each day (hover a day for per-category breakdown), pl"},{"id":"p8s3","text":"us a leaderboard of the most-used categories. Click a day to filter the summary chips/records below;"},{"id":"p8s4","text":" click again (or `×`) to clear.
- One chip per category with a count badge; click a chip to expand t"},{"id":"p8s5","text":"hat category's records inline.
- Each record shows time, name and arg preview; click to expand full "},{"id":"p8s6","text":"**参数 (args) / 结果 (result) / 错误 (error)**.
- Real-time filter by tool name/content; 全部展开 / 全部收起 butto"},{"id":"p8s7","text":"ns; “显示更多” loads more records lazily (default 40 per category)."},{"id":"p9s1","text":"### Mind-map canvas (one problem per canvas)
- Rebuilds the flow **问题 → 方案 1 →（报错）→ 方案 2 → … → 完成** "},{"id":"p9s2","text":"automatically from user/assistant/tool events.
- **One problem per canvas** — other problems live in"},{"id":"p9s3","text":" the **「问题画布」 tab bar** above the canvas; each tab shows a status dot (red = had errors, green = del"},{"id":"p9s4","text":"ivered).
- Attempt pills show reply summary, **报错** badge with the error text, and status badges: **"},{"id":"p9s5","text":"工作中** (running) / **完成** (delivered).
- **Click**:
- click a **problem** → expand/collapse all of it"},{"id":"p9s6","text":"s sub-flows;
- click an **attempt pill** → slide its tool-call chain in/out (collapsed pills show a "},{"id":"p9s7","text":"`×N` count);
- click a **tool chip** → detail panel: **做了什么** (what the AI did, from args), **输出 / 日"},{"id":"p9s8","text":"志** (result), **修改内容** (old → new diff, only when present), **参数**, **错误**.
- **Interactive canvas**"},{"id":"p9s9","text":": drag the background to pan, `Ctrl`+wheel or the zoom buttons to zoom; hover highlights the block; "},{"id":"p9s10","text":"the cursor gently repels nearby blocks.
- **Draggable nodes with inertia lines**: drag a problem nod"},{"id":"p9s11","text":"e and all its attempts/tools follow; connectors are elastic curves anchored to node edges that glide"},{"id":"p9s12","text":" after the nodes (inertia).
- Horizontal axis ≈ time — newer tool calls sit further right."},{"id":"p10s1","text":"### Zero extra token consumption
- Pure client-side aggregation; **no model requests, no LLM summari"},{"id":"p10s2","text":"zation**.
- Reuses the `trajectory` view projection built by `ui-trajectory` — no re-processing of t"},{"id":"p10s3","text":"he event stream.
- Defaults to collapsed / render-on-demand; args and results render truncated previ"},{"id":"p10s4","text":"ews until clicked; records load lazily (40 per category first)."},{"id":"p11s1","text":"## Dependencies"},{"id":"p12s1","text":"- `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-trajectory` — provides the `trajectory` view projection (data source)
"},{"id":"p12s2","text":"- `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-runtime`, `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-conversation`"},{"id":"p13s1","text":"## Installation"},{"id":"p14s1","text":"**One-liner (official bundle install):**"},{"id":"p15s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p16s1","text":"Restart the dsh web service and refresh the page — a **「分类」** tab appears in the conversation header"},{"id":"p16s2","text":"estart the dsh web service and refresh the page — a **「分类」** tab appears in the conversation header."},{"id":"p17s1","text":"**Manual install (when you want to control the patch layer yourself):**"},{"id":"p18s1","text":"1.
